source_record.reason: The same function exp_a appears on both sides. Because the paragraph also requires exp_a to have an inverse, it must be injective: exp_a(1)=exp_a(ln a) implies 1=ln a, hence a=e. This contradicts the stated arbitrary base a>0, a!=1.
